title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
abstract: arXiv:2610.26030v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, but truncation yields biased gradients that may weaken the benefit of looping. In this work, we study the value of truncation in looped transformer training in a systematic way: we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law

translated_title: 截断与否？截断反向传播下循环Transformer的缩放律研究
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过复用共享的层块来增加计算深度，而无需增加可训练参数的数量。它们通过时间反向传播（BPTT）进行训练。为了节省训练算力，BPTT通常被截断为只传播最后几次循环，但截断会产生有偏梯度，这可能削弱循环带来的好处。在这项工作中，我们以系统化的方式研究了截断在循环Transformer训练中的价值：我们联合变化模型规模、训练token数量以及前向和后向循环次数，进行了近600次训练运行，并拟合出一个统一的缩放律，通过有效参数刻画循环与截断的影响。尽管截断能够节省训练算力，但在联合优化前向和后向循环次数时，我们拟合的缩放律更倾向于完整的BPTT。在算力匹配的实验中，采用更少循环次数的完整BPTT始终优于相同算力下的截断设置。
tldr: 通过近600次训练拟合的统一缩放律表明，在联合优化前向和后向循环次数时，完整BPTT训练的循环Transformer始终优于相同算力下使用截断BPTT的训练方式。
en_tdlr: Through nearly 600 training runs and a unified scaling law, this study shows that full BPTT consistently outperforms truncated BPTT for looped transformers when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized, despite truncation's training-compute savings.
